title: Everyday Phrases — A First Date
scene_zh: 初次約會 · 情境對話
title_quote: Are we still on for tonight?
youtube_title: 【睡前英文聽力】💘 實用初次約會必備常用英文短句 ｜ 不用背！睡覺聽就會 ｜ 🌱A2 ｜ 💡400句循環聽 ｜ 零基礎也能開口說
youtube_title_en: 400 Everyday English Phrases While You Sleep — A First Date
youtube_description: 睡著學英文！這部影片收錄實用的初次約會情境對話（每兩句成一組：男聲常速 ➡ 女聲慢速 ➡ 男女連貫），從約會前確認時間地點、路上小緊張、見面寒暄點飲料、聊天認識彼此，到結帳散步與道別傳訊息，400句一次聽好。不用背，睡前聽就會。重複播放，讓英文自然進入你的大腦。👍 想學更多生活場景，請留言告訴我！別忘了訂閱+按讚。 #英文聽力 #睡前英文 #LearnEnglish
youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features practical A First Date phrase pairs (each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue), covering the whole journey: confirming time and place, nervous on the way, greeting and ordering drinks, getting to know each other, paying, an evening walk, and goodnight texts. No memorization needed—just listen before bed and absorb naturally. If you want more real-life scenarios, leave a comment! Subscribe and like!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are we still on for tonight?
dialogue.zh: 我們今晚的約會還算數嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Six o'clock still works for you?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Six is perfect, I'll be there.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We said the shop by the river?
dialogue.phonetic: /wi sɛd ðə ʃɑp baɪ ðə ˈrɪvər?/
dialogue.zh: 我們約的是河邊那家店，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yeah, that café with the red door.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛə, ðæt kæˈfeɪ wɪð ðə rɛd dɔr./
dialogue.zh: 對，就是紅色門面那間咖啡廳。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Same here, it's my first visit.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I book a table online?
dialogue.zh: 我需要先在線上訂位嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great, I'll see you at six.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Honestly, my stomach is in knots.
dialogue.zh: 老實說，我緊張得胃都揪起來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Really? It's just a friendly drink.
dialogue.zh: 真的嗎？只是輕鬆喝一杯呀。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It's our first time face to face.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts ˈaʊər fɜrst taɪm feɪs tə feɪs./
dialogue.zh: 是我們第一次面對面呢。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Same for me, my palms are sweaty.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪm fər mi, maɪ pɑmz ɑr ˈswɛdi./
dialogue.zh: 我也是，我手心都出汗了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Maybe I should change my shirt.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The shirt is not the problem.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How will I spot you there?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 那我就很容易找到你了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Work ran a few minutes late.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do you have enough travel time?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The bus is running behind today.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Trains are packed at this hour.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smart, it avoids all the traffic.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'm listening to a podcast now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Which one is it this time?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 那些技巧對你有幫助嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A little, I still feel awkward.
dialogue.zh: 有一點，我還是覺得彆扭。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two more stops and I'm there.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let me know when you arrive.
dialogue.zh: 你到的時候跟我說一聲。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Just walked out of the station.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The café is a short walk now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə kæˈfeɪ ɪz ə ʃɔrt wɔk naʊ./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is it on the left or right?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ɪt ɑn ðə lɛft ɔr raɪt?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Left side, past the flower shop.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You can smell the bread from here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju kæn smɛl ðə brɛd frʌm hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 你在這兒就聞得到麵包香。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They bake their own bread daily.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nice, we can share some later.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The cinnamon ones are my favorite.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 那這就是我們的第一單。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My phone is at twelve percent.
dialogue.zh: 我手機只剩百分之十二。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Charge it soon before you forget.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, save that battery for me.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, sorry I'm a few minutes late.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ, ˈsɑri aɪm ə fju ˈmɪnɪts leɪt./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You're right on time, sit down.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here, I brought you one flower.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 就一朵，希望不會太冒昧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 我也是，這感覺很不一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 哪裡不一樣，好的還是怪的？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 說真的，你讓人覺得溫暖。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You seem calmer than by text.
dialogue.zh: 你比傳訊息時冷靜多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I wrote long essays last week.
dialogue.zh: 上週我回了超長的訊息。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I noticed, your messages were huge.
dialogue.zh: 我發現了，你的訊息都超大篇。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 說說看，你是不是用跑的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 你現在看起來完全沒事。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My hair is a little wet.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's the nicest thing said tonight.
dialogue.zh: 這是今晚聽過最甜的話。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I've got plenty more of those.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 這個地方聞起來有肉桂香。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I love that about this café.
dialogue.zh: 這家咖啡廳這點我很喜歡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are you comfy in that seat?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You can see the river here.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It looks silver in the rain.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you wait long for a seat?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ju weɪt lɔŋ fər ə sit?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, this one opened right up.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 初次約會總有點奇怪，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only if we try too hard.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我們就享受這場小冒險。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ready to see the drinks menu?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The menu hangs by the counter.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Too far to read from here.
dialogue.zh: 離得太遠，這裡看不清楚。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Want me to go check it?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 拜託，我在這裡坐得太舒服了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Back in a second, stay warm.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 好，那我們這桌交給我去點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You order, I'll guard the table.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'm a big kid, what about you?
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪm ə bɪɡ kɪd, wʌt əˈbaʊt ju?/
dialogue.zh: 我就是大孩子，你要什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我的可可要加滿滿鮮奶油。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 哇，我們的飲料這就上了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 熱可可的氣味太幸福了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我可以嚐一口你的茶嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, but tea is my choice.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 你的茶要不要配點吃的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I doubt that's your middle name.
dialogue.zh: 我才不信那是你的中間名。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 這裡的音樂會不會太吵？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 有人把牆面漆成了藍色。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, my cousin told me about it.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, maɪ ˈkʌzən toʊld mi əˈbaʊt ɪt./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tell her thank you for me.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 初次約會的規矩：允許出糗。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 只吃了一顆蘋果，餓扁了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The scone can be my dinner.
dialogue.zh: 那個司康就能當我晚餐。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我也是，午夜麥片俱樂部。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 泡過餅乾的牛奶最好喝。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wait, is that a real thing?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 今晚我們就來實驗一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only if you buy the cookies.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'm treating, that was my plan.
dialogue.zh: 我請客，我本來就這麼打算。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 應該的，誰讓你打翻了可可。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I get you a refill?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This chair squeaks when I move.
dialogue.zh: 我一動這椅子就吱吱叫。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 那顆蠟燭是你最愛的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 說也奇怪，跟你的可可挺配。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 你那塊要抹奶油還是果醬？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Both, this is not a diet.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 看吧，我果然不會分一半。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This is going in my diary.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So what do you do daily?
dialogue.zh: 說說你平常是做什麼的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I work at a design studio.
dialogue.zh: 我在一家設計工作室上班。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 設計是指標誌和空間那種嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 聽起來很有創意也很忙。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you ever work from home?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fridays only, my desk is small.
dialogue.zh: 只有週五，我家的桌子太小。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 噢，那是責任很重的工作。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It is, one bug matters a lot.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz, wʌn bʌɡ ˈmætərz ə lɑt./
dialogue.zh: 是啊，一個錯誤就很要命。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do you stress about it at night?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju strɛs əˈbaʊt ɪt æt naɪt?/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My boss sends me cake sometimes.
dialogue.zh: 我主管偶爾會送我蛋糕。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How did you get into design?
dialogue.zh: 你怎麼踏入設計這行的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 我整個學生時期都在塗塗畫畫。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 然後就變成你的工作了？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you draw outside work too?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 你先給我看跑步的照片。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I never take photos when running.
dialogue.zh: 我跑步的時候從不拍照。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I played piano as a kid.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我會彈吉他，很初級的那種。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 大多是推理，從不看恐怖的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fat how, like a pillow fat?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 胖到會直接坐上我的鍵盤。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 叫麻糬，跟那種甜點同名。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I had a dog when I was young.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ hæd ə dɔɡ wɛn aɪ wʌz jʌŋ./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 這是最棒狗狗名字那一掛。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 你會想念有動物的日子嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 麻糬填滿了我每個晚上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Maybe one day I'll get a dog.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmeɪbi wʌn deɪ aɪl ɡɛt ə dɔɡ./
dialogue.zh: 也許有一天我會再養狗。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A calm one, with short walks.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 明智之選，貓咪認證通過。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A small town by the sea.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That sounds like a perfect day.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 有雪的地方，山裡的小客棧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I love coats and hot soup.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 你正式是「冬天派」的人了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 那你呢，你是夏天系的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ice cream makes me a fan.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 為什麼，這是要保密的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 美好的事情要安靜收藏。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's a line from a movie.
dialogue.zh: 這句話聽起來像電影台詞。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 我平常就愛收集這種句子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you watch films a lot?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: An old musical with rainy scenes.
dialogue.zh: 一部有雨景的老歌舞片。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 你的茶眼看就要喝光了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And one more pastry for you.
dialogue.zh: 順便再幫你點一份點心。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You know me too well already.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 這是我的超能力，抱歉啦。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we get the bill now?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I got this, my treat tonight.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I can pay for both today.
dialogue.zh: 今天我可以幫你一起付。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hold on, let me try one more.
dialogue.phonetic: /hoʊld ɑn, lɛt mi traɪ wʌn mɔr./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 現在可以去吹吹風了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I love that walk at night.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 濕濕的街道聞起來像新的一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: See the lights on the bridge?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They turn on at seven sharp.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 跟朋友還是自己一個人？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 什麼都能講到茶是我的才華。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I had more fun than planned.
dialogue.zh: 今晚比原本計畫的開心。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 那原本的計畫很無聊囉？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My plan was just to be polite.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ plæn wʌz dʒʌst tə bi pəˈlaɪt./
dialogue.zh: 原本的計畫只是保持禮貌。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 你可打翻過可可，記得嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 那可是我現在最愛的片段。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 這段散步你早就算好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 一半靠計畫，一半靠運氣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 路燈把我們的路上照亮了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 像一場小小的專屬遊行。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 參加者只有兩個人的遊行。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 再加上一個超冷的笑話。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 結實得像你多加的鮮奶油。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我想時間都聊天聊沒了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you book a ride home?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I want to, the streets are dark.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɑnt tə, ðə strits ɑr dɑrk./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 那我就小聲地說一聲謝謝。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only if you pick the place.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There's a bakery café I know.
dialogue.zh: 我曉得一家烘焙咖啡館。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 那條黃圍巾真的很適合你。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I got in ten minutes ago.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My phone is at five percent.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 週六六點，我記進行事曆了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 今晚我的緊張有露餡嗎？
